On the island of the monks of the White Raven Monastery, a brother disappeared in the Ghostlands. First you find the fisherman {npc:Dalbrect}'s {item:Family Brooch} in the Ghostlands, and from then on he takes you to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings}. Then the abbot {npc:Costello} asks you to investigate the disappearance of brother Fugio: you recover the {item:Monk's Diary} and receive a {item:Blessed Ankh}.
